title: SocialLife
description: SocialLife - Adds social life to your minecraft server
body:
# SocialLife - Friends System & Home Management

SocialLife brings a complete social experience to your Minecraft server, allowing players to manage friends, share homes, and stay connected through status updates.

## 🌟 Features

### Friend System
- Send and receive friend requests
- Accept or reject incoming friend requests
- See online/offline status of friends
- Personal status messages visible to friends
- Real-time status updates

### Home Management
- Set multiple homes with custom names
- Teleport to your homes instantly
- Invite friends to your homes
- Accept home invitations from friends
- Remove homes you no longer need
- Easy-to-use GUI interface

### User-Friendly GUI
- Clean and intuitive menu system
- Easy friend management
- Quick access to all features

## 📋 Commands

### Main Commands
- `/sl` - Opens the main GUI menu
- `/friends` or `/sl friend` - Friend management commands

### Friend Commands
- `/sl friend add <player>` - Send a friend request
- `/sl friend accept <player>` - Accept a friend request
- `/sl friend reject <player>` - Reject a friend request
- `/sl friend remove <player>` - Remove a friend

### Home Commands
- `/sl home set <name>` - Set a new home
- `/sl home tp <name>` - Teleport to your home
- `/sl home invite <player> <name>` - Invite a friend to your home
- `/sl home accept <player> <name>` - Accept a home invitation

### Status Commands
- `/sl status <message>` - Set your status message
- `/sl status set <message>` - Alternative way to set status

## 🔧 Installation

1. Download the latest version of SocialLife
2. Place the jar file in your plugins folder
3. Restart your server
4. That's it! No configuration needed

## 📝 Permissions

- `sociallife.friend` - Access to friend commands
- `sociallife.home` - Access to home commands
- `sociallife.status` - Access to status commands

## 💡 Coming Soon

- Friend groups system
- More GUI customization options
- Extended home sharing features
- Social achievements
- Status history

## 🐛 Bug Reports

Found a bug? Please report it on our GitHub issues page with:
- Server version
- Plugin version
- Steps to reproduce
- Expected vs actual behavior
